name: skylos
description: Runs the local Skylos CLI on Cursor agent edits, file reads, shell installs and stop: blocks reads of files with hard-coded secrets and installs of packages that don't exist or look like typosquats, and sends a follow-up at stop while issues the agent added are still open. Needs the skylos command, 4.44.0 or newer, on PATH (pip install skylos).
